project.name: otlp4j-service
project.description: The otlp4j graph runtime: the typed in-process Pipeline API, the declarative gateway configuration model, the service graph builder, validation diagnostics, and the started gateway runtime. JPMS module dev.nthings.otlp4j.service - depends only on otlp4j-core; no transport module is a dependency and none depends on this module. This module ships the complete component registry, service graph, gateway builder, and started gateway runtime.
